testcase.name: rapid scenario taps cannot replace active offer and repeated reads cannot duplicate delivery
daytime scenario is reproducible and explicitly not a real measurement
profiles have distinct offer identities and independent local states
nothing is generated just by creating or observing the simulator
ineligible and waiting scenarios generate no offer
generated presented accepted started and completed are separate idempotent transitions
bedtime scenario uses only illustrative context not device bedtime
only current offer is retained after many demonstration rounds
two explicit rejections represent pause until reset with no duplicate counting
reset is repeatable but late callbacks never affect a new offer
